summary.problem: Persisted wiki build could fail with SQLite foreign key errors when wiki relations referenced pages later in the same batch.
summary.fix: Queue wiki relations during page insertion and persist them after all pages in the batch are written.
summary.regression: Added a repository regression test covering forward references within the same persisted batch.

remaining_risks: Any future code that expects relations to exist before the full page batch is present should use the queued relation pattern.
recommended_next_task: Re-run the disposable QA wiki build flow on a fresh dataset that produces multiple categories/topics and validate the evidence/validation routes end-to-end.
